incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — HIGH QPS spike detected for org:nova-retail (org_id=nor-123). Sustained 3x baseline QPS, error rate climbing to 5% (5m). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/rerank. Alert: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/alerts/1799999999 (runbook: /runbooks/org-qps-spike)
ben_oncall: Acked. Oncall Ben here, jumping in. Pulling logs and current rate limits.
alice_sre: I'm seeing a big tail of long-running token loops from reranker jobs — they account for ~45% of recent token consumption. Median latency up 140ms, p95 1.2s.
carla_custsuccess: Carla — I've DM'd Nova's engineer and product lead. They're confirming a user-side batch job started overnight, not intentional. They asked for asap mitigation; customer-facing timeouts reported.
eli_platform: Suggestion: apply a targeted org-level QPS cap to 80 qps (current baseline ~240 qps) and disable heavy rerank feature flags for that org to quickly kill token churn. Also roll traffic to smaller model variant (mistral-medium) for non-priority routes.
ben_oncall: I can apply the override. Doing a controlled changelog/command now.
ben_oncall: ```
# Applying emergency org throttle
/org-override --org nor-123 --qps 80 --expires 2h --note "emergency spike mitigation: disable rerank + model-fallback"
feature-toggle set --org nor-123 --feature reranker false --expires 2h
route-policy apply --org nor-123 --route "/v1/generate" --model mistral-medium --expires 2h
```
incident-bot: Command accepted — override requested by ben_oncall. Change ID: chg-20260317-998. Will propagate to edge within ~30s.
ben_oncall: Propagated. Edge reports: throttle active, enforcement nodes returning 429 for excess QPS, rerank toggled off.
alice_sre: After 2 minutes: error rate down to 1.1%, median latency back to 85ms, token burn down ~65% vs peak. Charts look like the mitigation is working.
carla_custsuccess: Customer notified: "We've applied a temporary traffic shaping and disabled non-essential reranking to stabilize your service. We're investigating root cause; ETA for rollback 2h. Replying with support ticket #INC-2199." :white_check_mark:
dave_account: Dave (AM) — flagged to Nova leadership that we've applied a temporary cap and offered an incident bridge if they want us to coordinate further. They're grateful for fast action.
eli_platform: Logging action items: 1) create follow-up runbook entry for automated rerank detection; 2) schedule post-mortem with Nova; 3) consider auto-detection to suggest feature-toggle on anomalies. I'll file GH issue.
ben_oncall: Creating a short post-incident checklist now and will leave override TTL at 2h unless we extend with approval. If metrics stay stable for 30m, we can consider a phased increase.
alice_sre: Agree. I'll keep monitoring charts and CPU on inference pool. If we see any queue buildup on fallback model, we throttle further or temporarily enable burst queueing.
carla_custsuccess: Ticket INC-2199 created and linked to the change. Customer contact: emily@nnovaretail.com. They want a short summary once rollback starts.
ben_oncall: Leaving note: will handoff at next shift if still active. Ping me if anything regresses. :hand:
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-check in 30m to evaluate rollback readiness (chg-20260317-998).
